entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6257625719430982016: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 13.6906 +/- 0.0239 mas (same row, RUWE 1.13): 73.04 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -53.558, -52.391 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.54 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Díez Alonso et al. 2018, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-240 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018MNRAS.480L...1D/abstract). Mass 0.58 +/- 0.01 solar masses from Díez Alonso et al. 2018, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-240 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018MNRAS.480L...1D/abstract). Temperature 3810 +/- 17 K from Díez Alonso et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-240 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,810 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffcf9c. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,810 K and log g 4.74 (u1 0.422, u2 0.329): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
